# WalPanel Inc.

> Composite wall panels, exterior cladding, capped composite deck boards in Walnut, and modular composite fence panels and gates — architectural WPC (wood-plastic composite) — stocked locally at a by-appointment showroom in Chatsworth, Los Angeles. Serving Los Angeles, Santa Monica, Burbank, Glendale, Encino, Sherman Oaks and the San Fernando Valley. Sells to homeowners and contractors with same-day/next-day pickup and ~60-mile delivery.

## Products
- [Composite Wall Cladding Panels (WPC)](https://walpanelinc.com/cladding.html): HLC-49 series architectural composite wall cladding, 8-5/8" wide, in 108" and 114" lengths, stocked colors including the new Maple finish, from $35.36 per board (~$5.90/sq ft material).
- [Composite Deck Boards (WPC)](https://walpanelinc.com/decking.html): Capped composite decking in Walnut (single stocked color), 1 in. x 6 in. x 16 ft with grooved edges for hidden fasteners, 8 sq ft covered per board, $35.36 per board (same price as the 108" cladding board, ~$4.42/sq ft material).
- [Composite Fence Panels (WPC kits)](https://walpanelinc.com/fence.html): Modular 6 ft x 6 ft composite fence sections with aluminum top rail and hardware included, $248 per set; extra posts $90.
- [Composite Privacy Gates (WPC)](https://walpanelinc.com/fence.html#gates): Matching 4 ft x 6 ft gates in a powder-coated aluminum frame, fully assembled with lock set, keys, and hinges, $398 each; teak or black wood grain.
- [Black Composite Fence Kit (WPC)](https://walpanelinc.com/black-wpc-fence-kit): Single-SKU page for the black 6x6 privacy fence kit, $248/set — what's in the kit, FAQs, and ordering.

## Notes
- Service area: Los Angeles, Santa Monica and the San Fernando Valley, ~60-mile delivery radius from Chatsworth, CA 91311.
- Payment: Zelle or cash; 9.75% California sales tax applied at checkout.
- WalPanel Inc. is the local retail arm of Wallshell (architectural composite specialist, est. 2002).
